pr_title: Translate siri requests to turn on thermostats to valid targets
pr_body:
## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
Translate siri requests to turn on thermostats to valid targets

Siri always requests auto mode even when the device does not
support auto which results in the thermostat failing to turn
on as success is assumed.  We now determine the heat cool
target mode based on the current temp, target temp, and
supported modes to ensure the thermostat will reach the
requested target temp.

## The problem
<!-- 
  Describe the issue you are experiencing here to communicate to the
  maintainers. Tell us what you were trying to do and what happened.
-->

I have a tado° Smart Thermostat V3+ connected via the HomeKit Controller. When attempting to turn on the Thermostat via Siri to say to 23 °C, it changes on the HA frontend but does not turn on.

I get an error within HA ``The entity: climate.living_room_thermostat does not have a 3 mode``.

**Expected Behaviour:**

When asking Siri, "hey Siri, turn the heating to 23°. It should turn **on** the thermostat and if the setting is anything other than 23°, it should be switched. This is consistent to how it works when the tado bridge is connected directly to HomeKit.

- Last working Home Assistant Core release (if known): **Unknown**
- Operating environment (OS/Container/Supervised/Core): **Supervised**
- Integration causing this issue: **HomeKit Controller**
